en: Dependent on a state that is neither a refuge nor root-cause … pe … dependent on a state that is neither a refuge nor rootless … pe … dependent on a state that is neither a refuge nor associated with a root-cause … (Abbreviated.

one … pe … under resultant condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance condition: three.

pe ... dependent on a state that is non-proclivity, not-rootless, and not-root ... pe ... dependent on a state that is non-proclivity, neither-root, and dissociated from root ... pe ...
